texts.role_rule: A role is the lineup position where a player spent at least 70% of their minutes; otherwise the player is shown as mixed, with their two main roles.
texts.slot_rule: Within central midfield, a 6 spent at least 70% of those minutes in a defensive-midfield slot, an 8 at least 70% in a central-midfield slot.
texts.clock_rule: The 900-minute gate counts full-match equivalents: each match's minutes are scaled to a 90-minute match (120 with extra time), so stoppage time does not add to them.
texts.weight_note: Weights use nominal-equivalent minutes, the clock of the 900-minute gate. The season dot is display only: it is not part of the map's fit, the neighbour lists, the percentiles or the ranks.
